questions.q: Under which group do you create the ledger for your bank current account?
Which voucher records goods bought from a supplier?
The office rent ledger goes under which group?
The first two digits of a GSTIN show…
Which is the yearly GST return for a regular taxpayer?
Why fill in the GSTIN and state when creating a customer ledger?
options: So the company logo prints on bills
So Tally can work out staff salary
So the right tax type and GST reports come out
So the bank balance updates by itself

questions.q: Which voucher records depreciation or a correction with no cash or bank movement?
A ₹25,000 sale inside the state at 5% GST. What is the invoice total?
In Tally, where do you check your sales data before filing GSTR-1?
options: The GSTR-1 report under GST reports

questions.q: Yesterday you posted a sale to the wrong customer ledger. What is the right fix?
options: Open that voucher and change the party ledger
Enter the same sale again for the right customer
Pass a contra entry between them

questions.q: When can you claim ITC on a purchase?
options: When you hold the invoice, got the goods and the supplier reported it
As soon as you place the purchase order with the supplier
When you pay an advance, even before any invoice comes
Any time in the year, without needing an invoice

questions.q: You buy goods for ₹40,000 + IGST at 18%. What is your ITC?
A ₹60,000 sale to another state at 18% was billed with CGST + SGST by mistake. GSTR-1 isn't filed yet. What do you do?
options: Correct the invoice to IGST ₹10,800 before filing
Leave it, since the total tax is the same
Add IGST on top of CGST and SGST
Change only the customer's state in the ledger

questions.q: GSTR-3B is filed after the due date with tax payable. What is usually charged?
options: Nothing, if filed in the same month
Late fee, plus interest on the tax

questions.q: Tally shows a negative cash-in-hand balance. What does this usually mean?
options: The bank has given an overdraft
A cash entry is wrong or missing
Normal, it fixes itself at year end

questions.q: A customer pays ₹50,000 advance for goods to be delivered next month. How do you record it now?
options: Journal voucher to the sales account
Receipt voucher against the customer, as an advance

questions.q: Under reverse charge, who can claim ITC of the GST paid?
options: The seller who supplied the goods
The buyer who paid it, if used for business

questions.q: GSTR-2B shows ₹12,000 ITC for the month. Your books show ₹15,000. What should you do?
options: Claim ₹12,000 and follow up suppliers for the rest

task.title: Fix the mistakes in this GST invoice
task.brief: Take about 15 minutes. Read the invoice below. Write: (1) every mistake you find; (2) the correct value or detail for each; and (3) the correct tax and invoice total. Assume all items are taxed at 18%. A good answer spots the wrong tax type, the wrong figures and the missing or wrong details, and shows the correct calculation clearly.
task.material:
TAX INVOICE
Seller: Sri Balaji Electricals, Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana. GSTIN: 36ABCPK1234L1Z5
Buyer: Kaveri Traders, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka. GSTIN: 29AAKFK567M1Z
Invoice no.: (blank)   Date: 14-11-2026
Place of supply: Telangana (36)
1. LED bulb 9W, HSN 8539, 100 nos × ₹120 = ₹12,000
2. Ceiling fan, HSN 8414, 10 nos × ₹1,800 = ₹16,000
Taxable value: ₹28,000
CGST 9%: ₹2,520
SGST 9%: ₹2,520
Invoice total: ₹33,040
key_points: Telangana to Karnataka is inter-state: IGST should be charged, not CGST + SGST
Place of supply should be Karnataka (29)
Buyer GSTIN has 14 characters; a GSTIN must have 15, so confirm it
Invoice number is missing and must be added

rubric.label: Correct GST
rubric.guide: 0 = misses the tax type and totals, 3 = some fixes right but totals wrong, 5 = IGST, taxable value and total all correct

rubric.label: Mistakes found
rubric.guide: 0 = one mistake found, 3 = about half found, 5 = tax type, place of supply, fan amount, GSTIN and invoice number all found

rubric.label: Clarity
rubric.guide: 0 = hard to follow, 3 = list given but working unclear, 5 = each mistake and its fix listed with clear working
